* [[Drakkar]] * [[Rabbit hole]] ==Notes== * Just south of the [[Norrhart Domains]] exit is a path that leads to a small enclosed valley. A [[rabbit]] stands at the start of the path. It will start downwards to the center when you approach. Be warned that this is a [[rabbit hole|trap]]. If you follow the rabbit to the center, [[Nulfastu Earthbound]] will spawn with about five dozen Vaettir around you and along the path. These are levels 15 to 20 in [[normal mode]]. To be safer, you can send someone to trigger the ambush while you wait atop the path and then fight your way down. Note that once triggered, the path also contains additional hidden Vaettir. For exploration purposes, you can circle the valley without triggering the spawns; just keep away from the center. *{{Vanquisher|count = 429|low = 330|high = 527}} ** The area around the frozen lake is the most dangerous; be aware that many small groups of [[Chilling Wisp]]s circle the frozen lake in a counter-clockwise direction. ** If you wish to fight less, avoid triggering the rabbit hole trap in the southeast. ** There are many other spots where hidden Vaettir will spawn, most notably in corners, around clumps of trees, and the graveyard between the two [[Sifhalla]] exits. ** If you talk to [[Kilroy Stonekin]], additional [[Stone Summit]] will spawn in their encampment. ** [[Koren Wildrunner]]'s group patrols a long route around the frozen lake and sometimes the surrounding areas as well. ** Sometimes you need to kill charmable animals to complete the vanquish. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Drakkar Lake}} * Frozen within the lake itself is a large creature. It is a champion of [[gw2:Jormag|Jormag]], one of the [[Elder Dragon]]s featured in ''[[Guild Wars 2]]''. * With a total 201900 pixels—the largest data currently known—Drakkar Lake is both the single largest explorable area in EotN and the largest across the entirety of Guild Wars, providing 6.886% of [[Guide to Legendary Cartographer#EotN|Cartographer's EotN title]]. * A [[w:Drakkar|Drakkar]] is the name for an old Viking longboat. {{Explorable areas in the Far Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Drakkar-See]]
